div.span: We are approved and accredited by the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control, our in-house COVID-19 Screening and Testing has the capacity to run approximately 200 samples a day with our state-of-the-art DNA PCR machine. Test results can be ready after 8 hours of sample collection.
Book an appointment with any of our specialists and be assured that you will be receiving expert information from years of experience and practice.

div.p: Any patient under these plans wishing to access care can Book appointments through the website, our HealthMate App or command centre. Upon arriving at the clinic, you will be required to present your insurance card at the front desk.

Depending on your plan, some services may not be fully covered by your insurance and you may be required to pay the difference. The front desk will inform you what those services may be depending on your insurer. Also expect to sign a bill for your insurer before you leave the clinic.
For other insurance companies that we may not partner with, we are also willing to offer you service and a comprehensive invoice after self payment so that you can be reimbursed by your insurer.

Our health consultation provides you with safe and quality care with our dedicated medical staff. You can discuss common medical ailments or general health complaints in our health consultation with our professional medical care providers.
